note: v2: Names, descriptions and grades are as PlayStation publishes them (Exophase official list). Every guide below is written for this entry, in our own words, as numbered steps; each step names the source it comes from. Where sources disagree, or no source pins a detail down, the trophy is marked disputed or unconfirmed and the guide says so instead of guessing. 206 cited steps in total; 57 backed by 2+ sources.

trophies.guide: This pops on its own the moment the other 54 trophies are earned; there is nothing extra to do for it. Work the 7-stage roadmap in this guide — story first, then the 100% checklist, then the stranger strands and the count-based clean-up — and check the tracker here after each session so nothing is left behind. No online play is needed: all 55 trophies are offline, in one playthrough.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

steps.t: Earn the other 54 trophies; the platinum has no separate task of its own.
Follow the roadmap: story (60-80 hours), then the 100% checklist (about 100 hours), then stranger strands and clean-up (about 10 hours).
Check the tracker after each session; the platinum pops as soon as the last trophy does, with no online play needed.

trophies.guide: Play the opening mission, Gone Fishing, to its end. It is the first story mission, so just follow the on-screen objectives and the trophy pops when the mission completes. It cannot be missed, and there is no mission replay, so there is nothing to prepare for in advance.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

steps.t: Start the story and play Gone Fishing, Jason's first mission, through to its end.
Follow the on-screen objectives; the trophy pops when the mission completes.
It is automatic and unmissable, so no preparation is needed.

trophies.guide: Finish every main mission in Chapter 1. The trophy pops at the chapter's end, so keep playing the story in order and do not worry about side content yet — except for one thing in this chapter: do the Lucia balcony meditation described under Positive Mental Attitude before Chapter 1 ends, because that one interaction is reported as possibly missable.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

steps.t: Play Chapter 1's main missions in order until the chapter ends.
The trophy pops when the first mission of Chapter 2 begins, so it is automatic.
Before the chapter ends, do the Lucia balcony meditation for Positive Mental Attitude — the one thing in this chapter that may be missable.

trophies.guide: Finish every main mission in Chapter 2. Like the other chapter trophies, this one pops automatically at the end of the chapter, so play the story in order. Keep a manual save at the start of the chapter: there is no mission replay, so a separate save is your only way back if you want to redo a section.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

steps.t: Play Chapter 2's main missions in order until the chapter ends.
The trophy pops when Chapter 3 begins, so it is automatic.
Keep a manual save at the start of the chapter; with 15 manual slots and no mission replay, a save is the only way back.

trophies.guide: Finish every main mission in Chapter 3. It pops at the chapter's end with no extra requirement. By now the side activities are opening up across Leonida, so try a new activity type when one appears — that progress counts toward Master of None and toward the 100% checklist later.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

steps.t: Play Chapter 3's main missions in order until the chapter ends.
The trophy pops after the first two missions of Chapter 4, so it is automatic.
Try a new activity type when one appears; that counts toward Master of None and the 100% checklist.

trophies.guide: Finish every main mission in Chapter 4. It pops at the chapter's end. This is also the chapter where the optional mission behind Maximum Withdrawal appears, so watch for the optional bank-job mission in this chapter and take it when it is offered, rather than leaving it for later.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

steps.t: Play Chapter 4's main missions in order until the chapter ends.
The trophy pops after the final mission of Chapter 4, Starting From Zero.
Take the optional Chapter 4 mission That's Where The Money Is when it is offered; it unlocks the bank-vault robberies for Maximum Withdrawal.

trophies.guide: Finish the final story mission. It pops when the mission ends and the story closes. After it, the game opens into free roam, so this is the point to switch to clean-up: open Progress, then Stats, then the 100% Completion checklist, and work through what is left.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

steps.t: Play the final story mission through to its end.
The trophy pops when the mission ends and the story closes; it is automatic.
After it, switch to free-roam clean-up: open Progress, then Stats, then the 100% Completion checklist.

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Breakfast Run. It pops when that mission ends, as part of the story, so there is no separate task and no way to miss it. If you are tracking the story, tick it off here as soon as it pops and move on to the next mission.
trophies.name: Trust

steps.t: Play the story until the Breakfast Run mission appears in Chapter 2.
Complete Breakfast Run; the trophy pops at the end of the mission.
It is automatic and unmissable, so no preparation is needed.

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission The Cartel Heist. It pops when the heist mission ends. Heists are story beats, not repeatable side jobs, so just play the mission through when it appears in the story order.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

steps.t: Play the story until The Cartel Heist appears in Chapter 3.
Complete the heist mission; the trophy pops at its end.
It is automatic and unmissable.

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Child's Play. It pops at the end of that mission, as part of the story. No preparation is needed; the mission itself is the requirement.
trophies.name: Family Matters

steps.t: Play the story until Child's Play appears in Chapter 4.
Complete the mission; the trophy pops at its end.
It is automatic and unmissable.

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Headliners. It pops when the mission ends. Play it when the story offers it; there is no side requirement attached to it.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

steps.t: Play the story until Headliners appears in Chapter 4.
Complete the mission; the trophy pops at its end.
It is automatic and unmissable.

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission VCIA Takedown, the takedown at Vice City International Airport. It pops at the end of the mission. The airport also matters for Catch Me If You Can, so remember the layout here — but that trophy is a separate, later task.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

steps.t: Play the story until VCIA Takedown appears in Chapter 4.
Complete the mission at Vice City International Airport; the trophy pops at its end.
Remember the airport layout here: Catch Me If You Can is a separate, later task at the same airport.

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Operation Savage Glory. It pops when the mission ends. Like the other named story missions, it is unmissable: play the story in order and it will come.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

steps.t: Play the story until Operation Savage Glory appears in Chapter 5.
Complete the mission; the trophy pops at its end.
It is automatic and unmissable.

trophies.guide: Reach 100% on the in-game completion checklist, which appears under Progress, then Stats, after the story. This is the longest trophy, around 100 hours of clean-up after a 60-80 hour story, and the hardest on the list. It needs the robbery sets (39 gang operations, 22 bank jobs, 7 payday loan jobs, 8 bank vaults), 100 optional tasks, and the collectible sets — KeenGamer lists 15 complete card sets, 100 WAiNK locations, 33 underwater discoveries and 100 Cocaine Flamingos among them. Do the story first, then work the checklist in the order this guide's roadmap gives, and tick off each part here as it clears.
trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.source: Exophase — official list; PowerPyx and KeenGamer

steps.t: Finish the story first; the checklist appears under Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion, and progress made during the story already counts.
Complete 100 optional missions (purple icons, plus black icons with pink letters); there are far more than 100, and each meditation counts as +2 if done with both characters.
Scan 200 of 277 base vehicle models with WAiNK and study 100 of 255 animals through binoculars.
Finish every robbery set (39 gang operations, 22 bank jobs, 7 payday loan jobs, 8 bank vaults), all underwater discoveries, shooting ranges and drone races, Bret's quests, and 70 of 80 challenges.
The checklist is closer to 60% true completion: most side quests are not required, and collectibles are only partly required.

trophies.guide: Complete any 250 stunts across Leonida. Stunts are jumps, under-bridge flights, knife flights and base jumps, and there are 397 in total, so you do not need them all — pick the ones near roads and bridges you already travel. Check the in-game stunt counter as you go; a stunt only counts once, so spread them out instead of repeating one spot.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

steps.t: Complete any 250 of 397 stunts; for the 100% checklist you need 300.
Mix the four kinds: 130 stunt jumps, 202 under-the-bridge flights, 40 knife flights, 25 base jumps — under-the-bridge flights are the quickest.
Track progress by region under Progress, then Activities, then Stunts, or on the map under Exploration, then Stunt Spots.
A stunt counts once only, so spread them out instead of repeating one spot.

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types at least once: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting range, pool, basketball, a video game, a race and a stunt. You do not need to win or finish any of them, just start one of each. Do this during the story as each activity appears, and use the tracker here to see which types are still untried.
trophies.name: Master of None

steps.t: Open Touchpad, then Progress, then Activities to see the 9 types and how many of each you have done.
Try each once: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball (scoring hoops), playing a video game, winning a race, performing a stunt.
You do not need to win or finish any of them, just start one of each.
Most appear naturally while working on other trophies, so do not force it early.

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges, across the 12 shooting ranges. Gold means beating the range's gold score, not just finishing, so learn one range's targets and timing first, then repeat the pattern at the others. Leave this for after the story if you like — the ranges stay open in free roam.
trophies.name: The Shootist

steps.t: Visit the 12 shooting ranges; there are 42 challenges in total.
Earn a gold medal in every challenge — beat the gold score, not just finish.
Learn one range's targets and timing first, then repeat the pattern at the others.
The ranges stay open in free roam, so leave this for after the story if you like.

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations. Each location is a separate race, so you must win at every one, not just 14 races in total. Learn the drone's controls on the first location, then work through the list one location at a time and tick each off here.
trophies.name: Top Fun

steps.t: There are 14 Top Fun drone race locations, with 42 drone races in total.
Win a race at every location — winning at the same location twice does not count twice.
Learn the drone's controls on the first location, then work through the list one at a time.
Drone races are also required for the 100% checklist, so this comes naturally in clean-up.

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Different means 20 separate race events, so repeating the same race does not add to the count. Try the race types as they appear — road, off-road and water races all count — and keep a note of which ones you have already won.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

steps.t: There are 40 unique race locations in total.
Win 20 different races; repeating the same race does not add to the count.
Road, off-road and water races all count, so try each type as it appears.
Keep a note of which ones you have already won, and tick them off here.

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Fishing challenges are one of the activity types, so meet Cal at a fishing spot when the challenge is offered and out-fish him. If you lose, try the challenge again — the trophy is about winning that challenge, not about a single attempt.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

steps.t: After the Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui, when you meet Cal, he will send a text marking a fishing location with a purple icon.
Follow Cal's fishing questline to the challenge.
Beat Cal in the fishing challenge; if you lose, try it again.

trophies.guide: Complete one arcade game, start to finish, at an arcade. Any arcade game counts, so pick the shortest one you can finish and play it through once. This also counts as one of the activity types for Master of None.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

steps.t: There are 4 arcade games (called Video Games in-game): Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III, Time Jackers Rewind, Bang For Your Buck.
The first three are playable on the TV at home from Chapter 1; Bang For Your Buck is at arcade machines around the world.
Finish all levels of one game at least once; you do not need to beat all its challenges.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's mission strand, through to his final mission. Stranger and side-character strands open as you play and their quest givers can be temporarily unavailable during parts of the story, but PowerPyx reports that all trophy-related quest givers return later, so do not worry if Andy disappears for a while — finish his strand when he is available again, in free roam if needed.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

steps.t: Andy's questline is marked automatically in Chapter 3 and is exclusive to Lucia; while playing as Lucia you get a call from Andy, then a text with her home address in Belville.
Complete her 5 quests in order: Climbing the Cellerichain (Parts 1-3), Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach!, Read the Label, then Puff Puff Pass.
The final mission is Puff Puff Pass; the trophy pops when it ends.
All quests are still available after the story, so finish the strand in free roam if needed.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's mission strand, through to his final mission. As with the other side characters, Kenton can be temporarily unavailable during the story, and PowerPyx reports that trophy-related quest givers become available again later. Keep playing, check back when his strand reopens, and finish it in free roam if it is still open after the story.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

steps.t: Kenton's questline is marked automatically in Chapter 1; after the mission Island Dreams he calls you, then is marked with a green KR icon in Key Lento.
He offers treasure-diving quests: he marks purple treasure-chest icons, you find the underwater treasures and bring them back, using the metal detector to dig them from the ocean floor.
Clear 7 shipwrecks for his questline in total; track it under Progress, then Characters, then Kenton Rees.
After Chapter 1 Kenton is temporarily unavailable, then returns in Chapter 2-3, so he is not missable.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's mission strand, through to his final mission. Billy's strand is one of the side-character strands, so work it when it appears and return to it when the character is available again. It is not a story mission, so it will not pop on its own from playing the main chapters.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

steps.t: Billy's questline is marked automatically after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, at Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County.
Complete his 5 quests in order: Thrillbillies, Twist Wrist Smash Grab, Mall Rats, The Impaler, then Hometown Heroes.
The final mission is Hometown Heroes; the trophy pops when it ends.
All his quests are still available after the story.

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 stranger mission strands across Leonida. A strand is a full chain for one stranger, not a single meeting, so finish each chain to its end before counting it. There are more than 8 strangers in the game, so pick the strands that open earliest and finish those first; the rest can wait for free roam.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

steps.t: Only certain questlines count as strangers: Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy and Eddie do NOT count toward this trophy.

Confirmed counting strands include Kirk (Skunk Ape: Search for the Skunk Ape, Search for Tree Effigies, Help Kirk Find Mr. Mangrove), Kyle (McKittrick Farm, Collect Chemicals, Buddy?), Yago (street race, Bumper to Bumper, Race Against Yago, Brother to Brother), and Pilot Pete (The Last Mile and his deliveries).
Finish 8 strands to their ends; a single meeting does not count.
All strangers are still there after the story, so finish them in free roam; track the count in the trophy list.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's mission strand, through to his final mission. Randy is a side character, so his strand runs beside the story rather than in it. If he is unavailable for a stretch, keep playing — PowerPyx reports that trophy-related quest givers return — and finish his final mission when the strand reopens.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

steps.t: Randy's questline, Randy's Wish List, is marked automatically after the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS, when you steal the Zorrusso for Randy and unlock the Key Cloner.
He then gives you a list of 16 sports cars he wants; track them under Map, then Robberies, then Randy's Wish List.
Scan high-end sports cars with WAiNK to see if one is on the list, then steal it and drive it back to his garage in the west of Vice City; delivering it in good condition pays more.
Finish the list; the trophy pops on the final delivery.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's mission strand, through to his final mission. Tyrone's strand is a side chain, so it needs you to seek him out rather than waiting for the story to bring him to you. Finish it in free roam if it is still open after the final mission.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

steps.t: Tyrone's questline is marked automatically after the Chapter 3 mission Here, Kitty Kitty; it is only available as Jason, not as Lucia.
Go to the Synthetic Labs in Vice City, marked purple, and destroy them in the quest Take Out Kitty Litter.
After destroying enough labs, Tyrone gives the second quest Spin On This; complete it and the trophy pops.
All of this is still available after the story.

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 meditation spots across Leonida. THIS IS THE ONE POSSIBLY MISSABLE TROPHY. In Chapter 1, after the main mission Down to Earth, find Lucia at Jason's house in the morning: she says she is going to meditate, goes to the balcony, and you must follow her and choose Accept. That balcony meditation is reported to disappear after Chapter 1, and it is unconfirmed whether it is required for the trophy — so do it, and do it before Chapter 1 ends. After that, meditate at every marked spot you find; make a manual save at the start of each chapter as a backup, since there is no mission replay.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.source: Exophase — official list; PowerPyx and KeenGamer
trophies.dispute: PowerPyx and KeenGamer both report the Chapter 1 balcony meditation disappears after Chapter 1, but PowerPyx says it is still unconfirmed whether it is required for the trophy — the author had done it when the trophy popped. GTAScoop agrees it is the only possibly missable trophy. Do it to be safe.

steps.t: In Chapter 1, after the mission Down to Earth, talk to Lucia in the kitchen in the morning; she says she is going to meditate and walks to the balcony.
Follow her to the balcony and choose Accept when prompted; she shows you how to meditate.
That meditation raises the counter by 1 in the Progress menu, but is not marked as a Meditation Spot like the rest — so it is unconfirmed whether it counts.

Meditate at all 18 spots across 10 locations; you can meditate with Lucia and Jason at each spot, which counts as +2 at the same location. Track it under Progress, then Collections, then Exploration, then Meditations.
For the 100% checklist you only need 15 of 18 meditations, and the final one needs both characters together, unlocked after Chapter 2 Coffee Break.

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt the unique animal Bret asks for. Hunting is one of the activity types, so take a hunting trip when Bret's request appears and follow the animal's trail rather than shooting at random wildlife. The animal is unique to this request, so it will not be a common animal you have already hunted.
trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.dispute: PowerPyx says Bret's questline is about hunting different animals he requests, and that it is still undergoing confirmation which animal exactly unlocks this trophy. GTAScoop lists it simply as hunting a unique animal for Bret.

steps.t: Bret Vogel's questline is marked after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break; while playing as Jason you get a text from Bret marking his first quest, Veteran Hunted, in Lummox County. It is exclusive to Jason.
After that quest he marks hunting spots with purple icons; hunt the animals he requests and bring them to Bret as Jason.
During the first quest he gives you the unique hunting rifle Killtelligence SM-69, retrievable from any weapon locker at Ammu-Nations.
It is still unconfirmed which animal exactly unlocks this trophy, so finish his questline and check the trophy after each hunt.

trophies.guide: Complete 3 collectible card sets. There are 18 card sets in total, so you only need 3 of them — pick the sets whose cards you already have most of, and finish those first. Cards are found across Leonida, so collect them as you travel rather than hunting one set at a time from the start.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

steps.t: There are 18 collectible card sets in total; you only need to complete 3.
Pick the sets whose cards you already have most of, and finish those first.
Cards are found across Leonida, so collect them as you travel rather than hunting one set at a time from the start.

trophies.guide: Use the WAiNK app to scan 100 locations: landmarks, curiosities and sculptures across Leonida. Open WAiNK at a landmark and scan it; each new location counts once. Do this as you explore, and save a dedicated sweep for free roam, when you can travel to the landmarks you missed without story missions pulling you away.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

steps.t: Scan objects with WAiNK by holding Up and then R1; there are more than 100, so it does not matter which 100 you scan.
The kinds are 31 landmarks, 35 curiosities and 23 sculptures, plus No Flusher tags.
Scan as you explore, and save a dedicated sweep for free roam.
WAiNK scans also count toward vehicle discovery and the 100% checklist.

trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges. There are 80 challenges in total, so you need 50 of them, not all 80. Challenges are the small goals listed in the game — stunts, races, activities and more — so many will complete naturally while you work on other trophies. Check the challenge list in free roam and pick off the easiest remaining ones.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

steps.t: There are 80 challenges in total; you only need 50 for this trophy, and 70 for the 100% checklist.
View and track them under Progress, then Challenges; the Completed checkmark is in the bottom right when scrolling over a challenge.
Many complete naturally while working on other trophies, so leave this for one of your last trophies.
Then pick the easiest and quickest challenges you still have left.

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, build a 4-star wanted level, then lose it and escape. Do it away from tight streets where police can box you in: get the wanted level up, then drive fast and far, break line of sight, and stay out of the search area until the stars clear. Your partner must be with you when the level is lost, so do not start this alone.
trophies.name: Hot Together

steps.t: This is only possible after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, when you can free-roam together as Jason and Lucia; call your partner by holding Right and pressing Triangle.
Cause carnage until you reach a 4-star wanted level, then escape on a fast sports motorcycle, cutting through traffic to get out of the search area.
If a helicopter chases you, shoot at it until it goes away; the trophy unlocks after you drive out of the red heat zone, not after leaving the flashing search area.
Easiest route: drive through the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County — police struggle to follow on the tracks and the helicopter cannot see you.
You will also get this automatically during the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is, which gives 4-star wanted levels at every large bank vault.

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner, without losing your wanted level — meaning you must keep the wanted level going through all three robberies, not clear it between them. Plan a route past three shops close together, rob each quickly, and keep moving with your partner so the police stay on you but cannot stop you.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

steps.t: This is only possible after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, when you can switch between both characters; call your partner by holding Right and pressing Triangle.
Hit 3 robbery targets (green icons on the map) while being chased by police the whole time, keeping the red and blue flashing wanted level — not the red heat level.
Equip an armored vest and sticky bombs from Ammu-Nations, and Zombix or Adrenaline for healing.

A good spot is the 3 jewelry stores in the north of Vice City, available after the Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs; rob a couple of items in each store, go into the back room and break the safe with sticky bombs.
The unlock is delayed: it pops about half a minute after leaving the 3rd shop, and if it does not pop, hit a 4th shop and keep going.

trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. A vehicle counts when you find it, and a WAiNK scan is reported to be enough to register one, so scan vehicles as you see them instead of only driving them. Work through the vehicle types as you travel — cars, bikes, boats and aircraft all count toward the total.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

steps.t: GTA VI has 557 vehicles at launch (cars, bikes, boats, helicopters, planes).
Use the WAiNK app from your phone (hold Up to use it instantly), look at a vehicle and hold R1 to scan it; scanning is enough, you do not need to drive it.
Stand at a busy road and scan all the vehicles passing by; you need 200 base-model scans for the 100% checklist, so this trophy comes automatically.
Check discovered vehicles under Touchpad, then Progress, then Vehicles.

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Wait for a fight with at least 5 enemies grouped together, activate Combat Focus, and take them down before it ends. Do not waste it on a lone enemy — pick a busy shootout, line the enemies up, and use the slowed time to land the shots.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

steps.t: Activate Combat Focus with L3 + R3 while aiming a firearm; it slows time and highlights vulnerable spots, and drains the purple focus bar.
Buff your focus first: eat or drink, wash your face or shower at home, and consume Adrenaline to extend Combat Focus.
Line up 5 enemies (criminals at gang operations work) and defeat them quickly without missing; use an assault rifle such as the Duke 556 and wear body armor from Ammu-Nations.
It does not seem to work on soldiers, police or civilians, and it gets easier at Focus Level 4, reached by shooting ranges, golf, pool, fishing and headshots.

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at Vice City International Airport — leave the airport in an aircraft that was not scheduled to depart, in your own way. This is a stunt-style trophy at the airport, so take a plane or helicopter from VCIA and get airborne without following a normal departure. The story mission VCIA Takedown shows you the airport layout first, so use that knowledge here.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

steps.t: Steal one of the large passenger planes docked to a departure terminal at VCIA — it must be connected to a passenger boarding bridge, not a plane on the airfield.
The easiest plane is the one at departure terminals E3/E4; drive through a fence around the airfield and head straight to it, or enter through the terminal on foot.
Inside the plane go upstairs, enter the cockpit, drive the plane backward to the airstrip, take off and fly away.
Fly at least 1 km (0.6 miles) away from the airport; the unlock is a little delayed.

trophies.guide: Steal a military tank and use it. The tanks are at Mile Zero Air Station, on the island at the south-west edge of the map in Mariana County, standing in the south of the air base. Drive in through the gate or use the stunt jump next to the south-east entrance, get in a tank and shoot enemies until the trophy unlocks.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.source: Exophase — official list; PowerPyx and GTAScoop

steps.t: Steal a military tank — GTAScoop lists this as stealing a military tank, and PowerPyx names the Rhino tank.
Find the tanks at Mile Zero Air Station, the island in the south-west edge of the map in Mariana County, standing in the south of the air base.
Drive through the gate or use the stunt jump next to the south-east entrance.
Enter a tank and shoot enemies until the trophy unlocks.

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Go in quiet: plan the entry, avoid the cameras and the staff's line of sight, take the goods, and leave before anyone raises the alarm. If you are spotted, the attempt does not count, so leave and try again rather than fighting your way out.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

steps.t: First finish the Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs; it unlocks the Snap Gun for silently lockpicking alarmed doors, and unlocks jewelry store robberies.

Break into a jewelry store through the back door using the Snap Gun — the gadget stays in your inventory, and approaching a locked door prompts you to kick it (triggers the alarm) or use the Snap Gun.
Enter the back room, look for a note with the safe code, and use the code to loot the safe.
A good location is Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City; if you are spotted, the attempt does not count, so leave and try again.

trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape, five times. This needs the optional Chapter 4 mission 'That's Where The Money Is…', after which you follow a security van into a bank while its vault is open — that is the route PowerPyx and KeenGamer report for bank vaults. Take the optional mission in Chapter 4 when it is offered, learn the vault routine, then repeat it at other banks until you have 5 escapes.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.source: Exophase — official list; PowerPyx and KeenGamer

steps.t: First finish the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is (Wait at the Cafe); it is marked automatically from story progress and is the introduction to bank vault robberies.

Tail a security van until it stops at a bank, then a guard carries a briefcase with cash into the bank and they open the vault; go in quickly while it is open and rob it, bringing your partner and holding Right to hand off one bag.
After the quest, pay Yasmani for tips about security vans ($10,000 a tip, after his earlier quests); he marks the vans with a purple icon — follow them to the bank.
Robbing a bank vault instantly gives a 4-star wanted level; escape on a fast motorcycle, then switch vehicles to become unrecognizable.
There are 8 large bank jobs in total; you need any 5 for this trophy, but all 8 for the 100% checklist, and one vault can pay up to $205,000.

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Find an armored truck on the road, stop it, take its cargo, and get away before the police close in. Plan your escape route before you start the robbery, so you are driving away while the alarm is still fresh, not working it out afterwards.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

steps.t: This is unlocked automatically in the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is; robbing the vault of a large bank counts as robbing an armored truck, because you tail the armored truck to the bank.
Tail the truck, wait for the guard to carry the cash to the vault, enter quickly, steal the cash and escape the red heat radius, or use a Pay 'n' Spray.

To do it earlier, find an armored truck driving around Vice City near banks, block its path, plant a sticky bomb on its back door and blow it up — sticky bombs are in the back of Yasmani's shop after his quests.
The trophy unlocks only after escaping the red heat radius.

trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida, clearing the fog from the whole map. Travel to every region, and fly over the dark patches on the map — PowerPyx reports that flying over them is the quickest way to clear them. Do this in free roam after the story, when nothing pulls you back to a mission area.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

steps.t: Fully unfog the whole map; this is best done using a plane.
Fly over all the areas with black fog on the map until the entire map becomes visible.
Do this in free roam after the story, when nothing pulls you back to a mission area.

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs — one per gang, nine in total. Gang operations are part of the 100% checklist too, so work them as you work toward A Long Road: find each gang's operation, rob it, and tick that gang off here. There are 39 gang operations in total, so you have more targets than you need.
trophies.name: Pest Control

steps.t: There are 9 gangs and 39 illegal gang operations in total.
Rob one operation belonging to each gang; for the 100% checklist you need all 39, so this comes automatically.
Operations are marked by yellow icons on the map when you go near them, and many are marked automatically from story progress.
Track them under Progress, then Gangs; scrolling over a gang shows how many of its operations you have robbed.

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Go to Ocean Beach and drink a cocktail with a view. GTAScoop names the Ocean View Rooftop Bar on Ocean Beach, but PowerPyx lists this trophy as currently unknown, so the exact bar is disputed — go to the rooftop bar GTAScoop names first, and if it does not pop, try the other beachfront bars on Ocean Beach in turn.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.source: Exophase — official list; GTAScoop vs PowerPyx
trophies.dispute: GTAScoop (updated 20 Nov 2026) names the Ocean View Rooftop Bar on Ocean Beach; PowerPyx lists this trophy as currently unknown. The bar is therefore disputed, not verified.

steps.t: Go to the Ocean View Rooftop Bar on Ocean Beach, the bar GTAScoop names.
Order and enjoy a cocktail with the view there.
PowerPyx lists this trophy as currently unknown, so if the rooftop bar does not pop it, try the other beachfront bars on Ocean Beach in turn.

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style — drive a car straight through the showroom's frontage and out onto the street. GTAScoop reports this as smashing out of a vehicle showroom, but PowerPyx lists it as currently unknown, so the exact showroom is disputed: pick a vehicle showroom in Vice City, take a fast car inside, and drive it out through the glass.
trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.source: Exophase — official list; GTAScoop vs PowerPyx
trophies.dispute: GTAScoop reports smashing out of a vehicle showroom; PowerPyx lists this trophy as currently unknown. The exact showroom is therefore disputed, not verified.

steps.t: Pick a vehicle showroom in Vice City and take a fast car inside it.
Drive the car straight through the showroom's frontage and out onto the street, in classic style.
PowerPyx lists this trophy as currently unknown, so the exact showroom is not pinned down — try showrooms in turn if the first does not pop it.

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Steal all 3 key valuables at Kingpin Bowling, one of the gang operations in Port Gellhorn. Before going there, buy sticky bombs from Ammu-Nations — you need them to destroy the safe. The trophy unlocks after you escape the police, not immediately when you pick up the third item.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.source: Exophase — official list; PowerPyx and GTAScoop

steps.t: Go during the Chapter 2 optional mission Hit Kingpin Bowling, marked automatically; Kingpin Bowling is a gang operation in Port Gellhorn.
Buy sticky bombs from Ammu-Nations first — you need them to destroy the safe.

Steal all 3 key valuables: the luxury watch in the south-east office, the unique shotgun Gutterball Moreland 850 on the table in the north-east corner, and the safe in the office in the north-east hallway.
The trophy unlocks after you escape the police, not when you pick up the third item; killing the enemies is not necessary.
If you do not get all 3 in the mission, wait until the robbery icon respawns, then go back and steal the remaining valuables — it is not missable.

trophies.guide: Have maximum strength with both Jason and Lucia at the same time. Check strength under Touchpad, then Jason & Lucia, then scroll to Strength. Work out together with both characters — while one works out, the other completes their training automatically — so you make double progress. Fitness clubs are all over Vice City, and you can also work out at home after the story.
trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.source: Exophase — official list; PowerPyx and GTAScoop

steps.t: Reach maximum strength with both Jason and Lucia at the same time.
This is only possible after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, when you can switch between both characters.
Increase strength by working out; buy a membership at a fitness club, and filter for fitness clubs on Map, then Activities.

Always go together with both characters (hold Right and press Triangle to call your partner); while you work out with one, the other completes their training automatically, so you make double progress.
Check strength under Touchpad, then Jason & Lucia, then scroll to Strength (heart icon); you can also work out at home after the story.

trophies.guide: Make choices that affect your Criminal Profile — PSNProfiles tracks a count to 500 for this trophy. Choices are the small decisions the game records as you play: how you handle jobs, people and the law. Play normally through the story and side content and the count will climb; check the profile counter in the game to see how far along you are.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.source: Exophase — official list; PowerPyx and PSNProfiles

steps.t: Perform 500 actions that affect your criminal profile; view the count by clicking the trophy in the trophy list.

Turn on Criminal Profile notifications in Settings, then UI, then HUD Notifications, then Criminal Profile = On; a demon face appears on the right of the screen whenever an action affects your reputation.

Actions range from Professional (stealthy objectives, destroying evidence, clean escapes) and Hardened (incapacitating without killing) to Violent, Psycho and Irredeemable (permanent, from excessive violence).
It happens passively while working on other trophies; every robbery and enemy encounter counts, so do not farm it early.

trophies.guide: This trophy is unconfirmed. PowerPyx believes it is related to the Payday Loans store from the prologue, and GTAScoop lists it as not known yet. Do not chase a specific trigger until a source pins it down — play through the Payday Loans content, try a second attempt at something you failed once, and check the trophy after each attempt.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.source: Exophase — official list; PowerPyx vs GTAScoop
trophies.dispute: PowerPyx believes this is related to the Payday Loans store from the prologue; GTAScoop lists it as not known yet. No source confirms the trigger.

steps.t: PowerPyx believes this is related to the Payday Loans store from the prologue — treat that as a lead, not a confirmed method.
GTAScoop lists this trophy as not known yet.
Until a source confirms it, do not chase a specific trigger; play the Payday Loans content and try a second attempt at something you failed once, checking the trophy after each attempt.

trophies.guide: This trophy is unconfirmed. PowerPyx believes it is from a UFO questline, and GTAScoop lists it as not known yet. It reads like a trophy for witnessing something strange or unexpected in the world. Do not chase a specific trigger until a source pins it down.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.source: Exophase — official list; PowerPyx vs GTAScoop
trophies.dispute: PowerPyx believes this is from a UFO questline; GTAScoop lists it as not known yet. No source confirms the trigger.

steps.t: PowerPyx believes this is from a UFO questline — treat that as a lead, not a confirmed method.
GTAScoop lists this trophy as not known yet.
Until a source confirms it, do not chase a specific trigger; explore the world and check the trophy after strange or unexpected events.

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: This trophy is unconfirmed in detail. PowerPyx believes it is from kicking enemies while driving a motorcycle, and GTAScoop lists it as not known yet. The description says a melee drive-by, so get a melee weapon, drive past a target at speed, and strike as you pass — try it on a pedestrian away from a mission, and treat the detail as unconfirmed.
trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.source: Exophase — official list; PowerPyx vs GTAScoop
trophies.dispute: PowerPyx believes this is from kicking enemies while driving a motorcycle; GTAScoop lists it as not known yet. No source confirms the trigger.

steps.t: PowerPyx believes this is from kicking enemies while driving a motorcycle — treat that as a lead, not a confirmed method.
GTAScoop lists this trophy as not known yet.
The description says a melee drive-by: get a melee weapon, drive past a target at speed, and strike as you pass; try it away from a mission and check the trophy after each attempt.

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 by laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from robberies, and contacts launder them for you for a cut — use your contacts regularly after each robbery instead of letting the bills pile up. The counter is cumulative, so it will reach $250,000 over the course of the robbery work for A Long Road.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

steps.t: First finish the Chapter 3 mission Credit Check (Meet Raul's Crew); it unlocks the Dye Pack Jammer to launder marked bills.
Rob banks and Payday Loans and bring the marked bills to a fence — Yasmani in Vice City pays the most.
Deliver a total of $250,000 in marked bills to a fence; it counts across all robberies, not in one trip.
Bank vaults give up to $205,000 in a single robbery, but only after the Chapter 4 mission That's Where The Money Is; it comes naturally while doing robberies for the 100% checklist.

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops, in total. Buy weapons, clothes, food and other shop goods as you play — the counter is cumulative across every shop, so normal spending adds up. If you are close at the end, buy the most expensive useful items you still need, such as weapons and upgrades, rather than wasting money on things you will never use.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

steps.t: Spend a total of $100,000 across all types of shops; the counter is cumulative.
Buying guns, car mods and tattoos is the fastest method, as these are the most expensive.
Shops include 14 mod shops, 19 Pay 'n' Sprays, 24 Ammu-Nations, 67 clothing stores, 17 footwear stores, 18 hair and beauty salons, 11 tattoo studios and 15 electronics stores.
If you are close at the end, buy the most expensive useful items you still need.

trophies.guide: Purchase all 8 garage properties. Garages are properties you buy, so save money for them and buy each one as it becomes available. There are 8 in total, and buying them also gives you somewhere to store the vehicles you discover for Whip It Good.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

steps.t: There are 8 purchasable garages and 4 story-related garages; you only need the 8 purchasable ones, costing $160,000 in total.
Garages become available after the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver (Steal the Crawler for Moses); you get a notification that a new app, Vice City Real Estate, is installed on your phone.
Buy the garages through the phone app.
A quick way to make money is robberies, especially later in Chapters 3-4 when higher-value robberies unlock.

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Open the Scooter Bros app, register a vehicle you own or have found, and repeat until 10 are registered. Use different vehicles, not the same one ten times, and register them as you discover them for Whip It Good.
trophies.name: On the Spot

steps.t: The Scooter Bros app is installed on your phone after the Chapter 2 mission Moses (Take A Vehicle to Moses).
You must buy enough garages first (see Little Boxes); each garage adds one or more parking spots to register more vehicles.
Drive stolen vehicles to Moses in Port Gellhorn; in his garage click Respray and Register. He unlocks from the same mission that unlocks the app.
Initially he only accepts vehicles without trackers; later in Chapter 3 you can also register cars with Standard Trackers at any Pay 'n' Spray.
Register 10 different vehicles; registering costs money, so use cheap low-end cars and bikes to keep expenses low.
